reviews.t: LOVE it MORE than my old dried up MAC
reviews.x: I am really picky when it comes to mascara and normally only order MAC makeup. However, I was so tired of spending the MAC money on mascara and it drying out in 2-3 weeks! I purchased this one and LOVE it MORE than my old MAC mascara AND it hasn't dried out yet. I will definitely reorder this one!!! Color great, stays on and the price is right!! GREAT BUY!!

reviews.t: No clumping, no flaking, dark black color, fuller longer lashes!

Super easy to apply. I honestly have never seen a brush design like this, the bristles are shorter and seem closer together and I'm not sure if its the formula of the mascara or if it is the brush but this mascara does not give me spider leg lashes at all, most of my other mascaras I have used tend to make my lashes clump toge
Love this mascara. It's not flakey and looks much more natural than many others I've tried. It doesn't irritate my contacts.

My only issue is that I wish it provided more volume. It's great at defining my lashes and I don't feel like I need much length, but was hoping for more volume. reviews.t: I use it almost every day because it is easy to apply
reviews.x: I have long, dark lashes, but they lack a little in volume. I tried this mascara because it is very difficult to find a paraben-free waterproof that does not smudge - this fits the bill. I use it almost every day because it is easy to apply, gives me thicker lashes with one coat (I rarely even wear eyeliner because I don't need to with this product), and most importantly it is waterproof, smudgeproof, sweatproof - this stuff survives TRX workouts, crying, and wiping, and I've never had it flake.

This mascara goes on thick and has a bit of an odor when you first put it on, but it STAYS put! It doesn't smudge! It's the FIRST mascara I've tried that really, really doesn't smudge. I love it. I can put in on and it lasts for more than a day if I don't take it off.

reviews.t: Prestige mascara at an awesome price! Meets all criteria
reviews.x: Prestige mascara at an awesome price! Meets all criteria: black, sleek, dramatic, but even with its intensity, it still appears natural, soft, and does not flake...ever. It lasts all day, but contains natural ingredients, so it's easy on sensitive eyes. This mascara lengthens, defines, and volumizes; it is buildable, so you can rock it day or night...you can get a more natural look or go more intense. Best mascara ever, and to top it all off, it's a great price. Can't go wrong.

I really like this mascara.  It took me several days to get used to it as it is much different than most mascaras I have tried in the past, however, once I got used to it I really like it.  The first application I noticed how much nicer my lashes looked.  I found myself getting smudges under my eyes, but now have learned how to apply it without ant problems.  It wears well all day and removes easily.

Current review: Horrible.  I don't mind that the brush is different. I do mind there were tiny eye last looking hairs the first time I took the brush out.  It clumps horribly and looks like cap. Never buying again, sad I have to find a new one that's com parable to the old one. My old review: Easy to wash off but didn't smear or smudge...better than any mascara I've used yet

I have searched far and wide for a mascara that was truly able to last even a few hours on me without smudging or flaking. I have finally found it! Mia Adora Bold Lash Effect also lasts all day without flaking off. I have not ever had to reapply. Have already purchased a second tube and will be a loyal customer.

Needed a new mascara for a wedding and I have to be careful with cosmetics as I have very sensitive skin.  This stuff was great! Didn't bother my eyes at all, I cried several times during the ceremony and the mascara didn't run a bit. I would definitely recommend this to anyone with makeup sensitivity!

I have been looking for a smudge free mascara for quite a while.  This had the words smudge proof so I thought I would try it out.  Way too much money for a mascara that is not as advertised.  The product  goes on well, but I still have raccoon eyes at the end of my day.  I guess I'm still looking.

I bought this mascara because I noticed my eyes were being bothered by my old brand, and I'm happy to say this does not bother my eyes at all - and it's a good mascara. I'm not used to the brush shape though, but that's just personal preference.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the mascara for not smudging or flaking and for staying put throughout the day.
Many reviewers say it is gentle and does not irritate sensitive eyes or contacts.
Several reviewers note it lengthens and defines lashes well, though some say it lacks volume or thickening.
Reviewers often describe a deep, true black color and easy application.
A few reviewers mention the formula being wet or runny on first application, and one notes an odor.
